title: Skeleton: single-file CLI, subprocess helpers, test harness
description: Create executable git-vouch (Python 3.9+, stdlib only) with argparse subcommand dispatch for every command in DESIGN.md Commands. Helpers: run git/ssh-keygen with argument lists, never a shell; registry values only after --. Input validation: handle regex ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,38}$, 64 KiB file cap. pytest dev harness that makes throwaway ssh-keygen keys in tmp dirs.
acceptance_criteria: git-vouch --help lists all subcommands; runs on python3.9; pytest runs with a fixture producing real ed25519 and ecdsa-p256 throwaway keys; no third-party imports.
